fullContentHtml:
LIC HFL Apprentice Online Form 2026 – Full Details

LIC Housing Finance Limited (LIC HFL) has released the notification for the post of Apprentice Posts on the official website. This recruitment has released for 232 posts. Applications for the LIC HFL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 has started from 20 October 2026, & candidate can apply until 01 November 2026. Candidates must check the complete details for LIC HFL Apprentice Recruitment 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Application Start Date : 20 October 2026
  • Last Date : 01 November 2026
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 01 November 2026
  • Exam Date : 07 November 2026
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • General, OBC, EWS (Male) : Rs. 800/-
  • General, OBC, EWS (Female) : Rs. 200/-
  • SC, ST, PH : Rs. 200/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.

Important Links

  • Apply Online
  • Download Notification
  • Official Website

LIC HFL Apprentice Online Form 2026 is an official government examination / recruitment update. Full details and direct links are provided on this page.
